questions.cardDe: Welche weibliche Shakespeare-Figur hat die meisten Zeilen: Kleopatra, Julia oder Ophelia?
questions.de: Welche Titelheldin einer Shakespeare-Tragödie hat die meisten Zeilen aller Frauenrollen in Shakespeares Tragödien?
questions.en: Which title heroine of a Shakespeare tragedy has the most lines of all the female roles in Shakespeare's tragedies?

source.title: Which female character has the most lines in Shakespeare?

questions.notes: Card asked Kleopatra / Julia / Ophelia (intended answer Kleopatra). Over all plays Rosalind (As You Like It, a comedy) usually ranks first and Cleopatra second with about 670 lines; counts vary by method, so the rework restricts to the tragedies. Imogen (Cymbeline, 591) is a late romance and has fewer lines anyway.
